# Copilot instructions

Follow the repository-wide instructions in [`../AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md).
`AGENTS.md` is the canonical source for shared agent guidance and should be
updated instead of duplicating general rules here.

Add content to this file only when it applies specifically to GitHub Copilot.
If a Copilot-specific instruction conflicts with `AGENTS.md`, the more specific
instruction in this file takes precedence.
